{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
p='process.mjs';s=open(p).read();s=s.replace("console.log('PAGE',page,await p.locator('main').innerText());", """const rows=await p.locator('tbody tr').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>({id:e.dataset.id,cells:[...e.querySelectorAll('td')].map(c=>c.innerText)})));for(const r of rows){const [id,customer,reason,amount,status]=r.cells;if(status!=='Pending')continue;const action=customer.includes('Blocked')?'Reject':reason==='Damaged item'&&Number(amount.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,''))<=500?'Approve':null;if(action){const row=p.locator('tr[data-id="'+id+'"]');await row.getByRole('button',{name:action,exact:true}).click();await row.locator('.ac').getByRole('button').waitFor({state:'detached'});console.log(id,action,await row.locator('.st').innerText());}}console.log('PAGE',page,await p.locator('main').innerText());""");open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
node process.mjs"}
